title.zhHans: Google 宣布推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen

searchSummary.en: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen and said it was starting a global rollout across developer, enterprise and consumer products.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并表示正开始向开发者、企业及消费者产品在全球推出。

summary.en: On November 12, Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen and said it was starting a global rollout across developer, enterprise and consumer products.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 12 日，Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并表示正开始向开发者、企业及消费者产品在全球推出。

narrative.en: The Google article is dated November 12 and last updated November 16. This is a bounded company statement about a phased rollout, not independent proof that every channel was live or that claimed benchmarks generalize.
narrative.zhHans: Google 文章标注 11 月 12 日发布、11 月 16 日更新。本条仅记述其分阶段推出的公司声明，不视为所有渠道均已开放或跑分可推广的独立证明。
